Compute Pedestrian Isochrone Polygons and Reachable Subgraphs

Source: R/isochrone.R
walk_isochrone.Rd

Generates spatial polygon isochrones (concave hulls or buffered envelopes) and extracts the exact reachable street network from an origin location for specified walking time budgets (e.g. 5, 10, 15 minutes).

Usage

walk_isochrone(
  network,
  origin,
  time_min = c(5, 10, 15),
  method = c("concave", "buffer"),
  buffer_m = 25,
  concave_ratio = 0.3,
  rings = TRUE
)

Arguments

network

A walk_network object produced by walk_build_network().

origin

Origin location: an integer node ID, coordinate vector c(x, y), or an sf POINT.

time_min

Numeric vector of walking time thresholds in minutes (e.g. c(5, 10, 15) or 10.0).

method

Polygon generation technique: "concave" for concave hull envelopes or "buffer" for street network buffering.

buffer_m

Buffer width in meters applied along reachable edges when synthesizing pedestrian walkable corridors (default 25.0 m).

concave_ratio

Ratio parameter passed to sf::st_concave_hull() (0 to 1, default 0.3).

rings

Logical. If TRUE (default), multi-threshold polygons are transformed into mutually disjoint, non-overlapping concentric rings (e.g. 0-5 min, 5-10 min, 10-15 min) via topological differences, avoiding polygon occlusion. Cumulative envelopes are still preserved in the cumulative_polygons element.

Value

A walk_isochrone S3 object containing:

polygons

sf polygons representing the isochrones (rings or cumulative).

cumulative_polygons

sf polygons with full cumulative envelopes.

edges

sf lines of all reached street segments with travel time.

origin

sf point of the resolved origin node.

time_min

The evaluated time thresholds.

rings

Logical indicating whether disjoint rings were generated.

network

The input walk_network.

Examples

data(streets_cusco)
net <- walk_build_network(streets_cusco, verbose = FALSE)
orig <- sf::st_coordinates(net$nodes[net$nodes$is_giant, ])[1, 1:2]
iso <- walk_isochrone(net, origin = orig, time_min = c(5, 10), rings = TRUE)
print(iso)
#> 
#> ── Walkability Isochrones ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Origin Node: 0
#> ✔ Enveloping Method: concave
#> ✔ Topology Type: Non-overlapping concentric rings (Disjoint)
#> ✔ Cutoffs Evaluated: 5 min, 10 min
#> • [0 - 5 min] Reachable length: 3.04 km | Area: 0.31 km² | Edges: 53
#> • [5 - 10 min] Reachable length: 10.36 km | Area: 0.56 km² | Edges: 123
